# Legacy Investing Show

> Tax strategy, wealth-building systems, and decision tools from Preston Seo for professionals, investors, and founders who want to keep more, grow faster, and build lasting wealth.

## Business Focus

Legacy Investing Show is a tax-and-wealth-first education brand.

Primary focus areas:
- Tax strategy and planning
- Wealth-building systems
- Retirement optimization
- Business structure and asset protection
- Investing and cash-flow decisions

Secondary focus area:
- Airbnb arbitrage and alternative income

## Who It Helps

- High-income earners
- Business owners and consultants
- Real estate investors
- Professionals building their first real wealth system
- People who make good money but feel like taxes, debt, and complexity are slowing them down

## Proof

- $15M+ personal real estate portfolio built by Preston
- 2,000+ students guided
- 6.5M+ combined social reach
- 30+ documented case studies and student stories

## Client Results and Reviews

Named Legacy Wealth Blueprint client case studies, each with a video interview and a full written case study:

- [Stephanie Dailey](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/stephanie-dailey-legacy-wealth-blueprint-case-study): software engineer, household W-2 income over $300,000, saved over $20,000 in taxes in her first year, captured a $27,000 startup cost deduction and deducted over $60,000 in mortgage interest
- [Albert](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/albert-legacy-wealth-blueprint-case-study): ER physician in California with a combined bracket he puts near 50%, net worth growth of 25%, self-managed 401(k) up about 19%, Roth up about 40%, home insurance cut in half
- [Abigail](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/abigail-legacy-wealth-blueprint-case-study): former oil and gas engineer, calculated just under $100,000 in first-year ROI against household withholdings of $37,000 to $38,000
- [Shawn](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/shawn-legacy-wealth-blueprint-roi-case-study): business owner who came for tax knowledge after struggling with CPAs, names no figures because the interview predates implementation

Third-party reviews:

- Trustpilot: TrustScore 4.2 from 66 reviews, 77% five star, 11% four star, 3% three star, 0% two star, 9% one star, at https://www.trustpilot.com/review/firstairbnb.com
- Better Business Bureau: Legacy Investing Show, LLC, Herriman, Utah, not BBB accredited

Every result published is self-reported and individual. It is not typical and it is not a promise.

## Most Valuable Content

- [Tax Strategies](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/): primary hub for tax planning, deductions, entities, and real-estate tax moves
- [Short-Term Rental Loophole](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/short-term-rental-loophole): step-by-step guide to the seven-day average stay test, material participation, and cost segregation
- [Depreciation Recapture on a Short-Term Rental](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/depreciation-recapture-str): the honest math on Section 1250 and Section 1245 recapture when you sell
- [REPS vs the STR Loophole](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/reps-vs-str-loophole): the 750-hour test against the 100-hour test for W-2 earners
- [Bonus Depreciation in 2026](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/bonus-depreciation): the 100 percent rate for property acquired after January 19, 2025
- [Compare Guides](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/): tax strategy scorecards plus education and program-choice guides
- [BiggerPockets alternatives](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/biggerpockets-alternatives): education options grouped by job, not software
- [SubTo alternatives](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/subto-alternatives): creative-finance school vs cheaper rental study and a wealth plan
- [Money Guy FOO vs Ramsey Baby Steps](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/money-guy-foo-vs-ramsey-baby-steps): two dollar orders, public prices, not mortgage math
- [WealthAbility alternatives](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/wealthability-alternatives): tax class vs CPA vs attorney membership vs a written plan
- [Legacy Wealth Blueprint cost](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-cost): current published sticker and a coaching buyer scorecard
- [Anderson Platinum vs a tax course](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/anderson-platinum-vs-tax-course): attorney membership vs education-only
- [Wealth plan checklist for high earners](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/wealth-plan-checklist-high-earners): export facts before buying a class
- [Free Tools](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/): 100+ free calculators for tax, STR, real estate, debt, retirement, and money decisions
- [Personal Money Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/money): budgets, savings goals, debt payoff, and net worth
- [Banking & Borrowing Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/banking-borrowing): loans, APY, amortization, and credit costs
- [Taxes & Payroll Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/taxes-payroll): take-home pay, withholding, and tax reserves
- [Housing & Moving Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/housing-moving): rent, mortgages, equity, and move-in costs
- [Insurance Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/insurance-protection): renters, auto, pet, health, and income protection
- [Blog](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/): strategy articles, case studies, and transcript-based resource posts
- [Success Stories](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/success-stories): curated student results and execution stories
- [Reviews and client results](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/reviews): the proof page for Preston Seo and the Legacy Investing Show. 4 Legacy Wealth Blueprint client case studies on video with figures and verbatim quotes, 44 written client results, 8 headline client result figures, a 4.2 TrustScore from 66 Trustpilot reviews, 19 Airbnb client case studies, and 76 pages from real client wealth plans with their text transcribed into the page
- [Reviews, plain text mirror](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/llms/reviews.txt): the full text of the reviews page, including every client case study summary, every verbatim quote, every written client result, and the transcribed text of every wealth plan page
